baseline: Qualified V12 full Triton Qwen3-8B with vocabulary-parallel CE and fused dW
candidate_gradient_rule: Every coordinate of all399 local FP32 gradients; per-parameter norm(error) < .06*max(norm(reference),1e-8)+1e-6; forward logits relativeL2<.025 and loss abs<.01
states: BF16 compute, FP32 masters/gradients/moments, no TF32 or reduced-precision BF16 accumulation
performance_anchors: fresh native HF with the same shared infrastructure settings
selection: First clean attempt only; dirty resource attempts excluded and preserved; clean technical failures stop; no timing-based repeat selection
scope: Short screens cannot establish adoption. Deterministic-fill-dependent gains must be disclosed as limited to that protocol; compare common fill=False baselines before general production recommendation. Symmetric-memory probe is availability/correctness only, not an integrated training result.
validation_memory_policy: After synchronization, physically release peer buffer before no-grad validation. Restore it and lower Torch allocator cap before training. Sticky error flag and coverage counters persist. The effective cap remains41.875GiB; no validation sample/batch reduction.
order_reason: Run the previously failing shared-HF full validation first after fixing buffer lifetime; old failed cohort is preserved and not used for new performance selection.
